benefits: The Pearson Scholarships cover tuition, books, incidental fees, and full residence support for four years
Approximately 37 students new and returning annually
The programme has provided more than CAD 12 million of funding in 2024
The programme and its recipients represent a total of 188 countries
The scholarship is renewable for three additional years (a total of four years) provided the student continues full-time undergraduate studies at the University of Toronto
eligibility: International student: not a Canadian citizen or permanent resident, and requiring a study permit at the time of application
Final year of senior secondary school in 2026/2027, or graduated no earlier than June 2026
Beginning studies at the University of Toronto in September 2027
Students already enrolled in post-secondary education, or students starting post-secondary in January 2027, are not eligible
Students currently attending high school outside Canada or outside Ontario are encouraged to apply for the Pearson International Scholarship
requirements: Nominated by your current secondary school (one student per year; the school must be verified and apply to participate by 12:00 noon EST on 9 October 2026)
Apply for admission through the Ontario Universities' Application Centre (OUAC) by the 16 October 2026 deadline
Submit the Pearson scholarship application form and supporting documents by 6 November 2026
selection_criteria: All applicants are selected by the Pearson Scholarship committee based on academic achievement, creativity, leadership, and commitment to the community
coverage: Full residence support for four years
application_method: Ask your current secondary school to verify its participation with the University of Toronto on the Pearson portal and then nominate you (one student per year) by 9 October 2026
Apply for admission through OUAC and to the University of Toronto by 16 October 2026
Submit the Pearson scholarship application form and supporting documents by 6 November 2026; questions go to the Pearson Scholarship team by email
official.application_route: Only through nomination by your current secondary school onto the Pearson application form after the school participates on the portal - self-nomination is impossible, so secure the nomination first.
official.citizenship_residency: International student status: not a Canadian citizen or permanent resident, and requiring a study permit
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the award is designed for international students who require a Canadian study permit; students attending high school outside Canada and outside Ontario are encouraged to apply
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Tenable only at the University of Toronto, for first-entry undergraduate programs, restricted to the program selected on the Pearson scholarship application form
official.duration: Four years (entering September 2027), renewable for three additional years
official.description: The Pearson International Scholarship at the University of Toronto covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years for outstanding international students beginning first-entry undergraduate studies in September 2027.
official.program_type: Full-ride undergraduate scholarship for international students (Pearson International Scholarship)

applicant_utility.summary: Pearson is one of the few true full rides - it pays tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years - but you cannot apply yourself: a current secondary school must nominate you through its own participating portal account, one student per year, by noon EST on 9 October 2026. With that nomination door now closed for the 2027 cycle, the only steps still salvageable are the OUAC admission application by 16 October 2026 and the Pearson application form with supporting documents by 6 November 2026, if you were already nominated. Ignore anyone offering agent services: the official page states that offices and agents have nothing to do with the process.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Final-year international secondary students with an exceptional record of academics, creativity, leadership and community commitment who can get nominated by their own current school.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm whether your school is a participating school on the Pearson portal and, if nomination is still open, that it can nominate you by the noon EST deadline
If nominated: submit the OUAC admission application by 16 October 2026 and include the University of Toronto
Complete the Pearson scholarship application form and upload supporting documents by 6 November 2026
Choose one intended program of study carefully - the award is restricted to the first-entry undergraduate program selected on the application form
Track notifications from end January 2027 onward: nominations, offers, acceptances and wait lists, all resolved by end of April 2027
common_rejection_risks: Assuming self-application is possible - nomination by your current secondary school is the only route published
Missing the staggered deadlines: nomination (9 October), OUAC admission (16 October), Pearson application and documents (6 November)
Applying through an agent: the page warns offices and agents have nothing to do with the process and the university bears no responsibility for errors by third parties
Being ineligible on status: already enrolled in post-secondary, or starting post-secondary in January 2027
Losing the scholarship later by not maintaining full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic standing
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Travel to Toronto, personal costs beyond books, incidental fees and residence support, and other discretionary expenses.
document_audit: A nomination does not equal a scholarship - the student must still submit the Pearson application form and supporting documents by 6 November 2026
Questions must go to the Pearson Scholarship team's email on the official page, not to any third-party agent or consultancy
alerts: Generative AI tools must not be used to create your application content - applicants caught using them are disqualified
Decisions arrive from late January to April 2027, so keep the email used for the application active and do not duplicate submissions
Students attending high school outside Canada and outside Ontario are expressly encouraged to apply, so overseas schooling is not a disadvantage
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: School verifies participation and nominates the student on the portal, student applies to U of T via OUAC, student completes the Pearson form and uploads documents, the committee selects on academics, creativity, leadership and community commitment, and outcomes land from end January to end April 2027.
